first.rationale: Verify the pricing claim because it is highly consequential against the competitor but its revenue lift may not translate into sustainable qualified revenue. Verify onboarding evidence because completion and activation are both currently declining, making this a direct, lower-margin-risk intervention. Run a guarded onboarding simplification test while monitoring qualified pipeline, retention, and account quality; do not assume activation gains alone guarantee downstream revenue.

final.rationale: Run a standard, controlled onboarding simplification experiment. The verified source shows completion increased 13%, time-to-value fell by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention improved 3%, directly addressing the current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable revenue. Measure qualified revenue, activation, retention, and account quality downstream. Do not use aggressive promotional pricing: its 31% signup and 18% qualified-revenue lift was offset by a 12% 30-day retention decline and failure at the first renewal cycle.
